trust_decision.summary: Whether a raw transaction hash still counts as 'already seen' (i.e. is replay-protected) is decided in one place: ValidityStore::has_transaction sets the window start to last_bn - Policy::transaction_validity_window_blocks(), so a hash recorded in the oldest protected block falls out of the guard up to blocks_per_batch blocks before the transaction itself stops being valid.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'validity store off by one error'. The only window arithmetic on the validity store is this lookback in ValidityStore::has_transaction; the pruning constant three functions below (line 140-143) already uses window + blocks_per_batch, which is the discrepancy.

fix_sites.entry_point: Blockchain::contains_tx_in_validity_window (blockchain/src/blockchain/wrappers.rs:197-203) through HistoryStoreProxy (blockchain/src/history/history_store_proxy.rs:238-251) -> HistoryStoreMerger (blockchain/src/history/merged_history_store.rs:170-176) -> HistoryStore/HistoryStoreIndex -> ValidityStore; reached from RPC pushTransaction (rpc-server/src/dispatchers/mempool.rs:34-38 -> mempool/src/mempool.rs:616 -> mempool/src/verify.rs:55) and from block import (blockchain/src/blockchain/push.rs:596)
fix_sites.module_kind: internal database-backed store in the blockchain crate's history module (the sink behind the wrapper/proxy chain)

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The transaction validity contract itself: a transaction is includable from validity_start_height - blocks_per_batch through validity_start_height + window - 1, as encoded in Transaction::is_valid_at and relied on by micro-block verification (primitives/block/src/micro_block.rs:325) and by the web client's expiry boundary (web-client/src/client/lib.rs:67-70, asserted at web-client/src/client/lib.rs:1399-1427). Folding blocks_per_batch into Policy::transaction_validity_window_blocks (the one-constant 'fix') silently changes consensus validity and those callers, not just the replay window.

O6_input_shapes: transaction included at the earliest block at which it is valid: validity_start_height = first_inclusion_block + blocks_per_batch (the shape the published fix adds)
transaction whose validity_start_height equals its inclusion block (the shape the pre-existing pinned tests use, still protected)
boundary of the replay window: still protected at validity_start_height + window - 1, no longer protected at validity_start_height + window
hash never seen (absent from the txn_hashes table) and the RawTransactionHash::default() placeholder rows written for blocks with no transactions

O7_producer.where: blockchain/src/history/validity_store.rs:10 (txn_hashes table), populated by add_transaction (blockchain/src/history/validity_store.rs:86-94) from blockchain/src/history/history_store.rs:412-414 when a block's historic transactions are stored; the reference height used by the check is produced by update_validity_store (blockchain/src/history/validity_store.rs:159-165) from blockchain/src/history/history_store.rs:421-423

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the index wrapper computes its own replay lookback from its tx_hash_table instead of delegating to the store's validity store
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: HistoryStoreIndex already duplicates per-block and per-address lookups over its own tables, so a maintainer could plausibly answer 'is this hash recent?' from the index and get the window arithmetic wrong in a second place.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second validity-window computation for the browser client's pending/expired transaction filter
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The repo already carries exactly this class of sibling bug there: the pinned test web-client/src/client/lib.rs:1364 is named expiry_check_uses_block_count_not_batch_count, i.e. the same window confusions recur in that package.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an independent window boundary (tx_validity_window_start + transaction_validity_window_blocks() - 1) computed next to a query into the same sink
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The validator already derives its own boundary and then asks tx_in_validity_window, so a maintainer could easily have moved the whole lookback decision into this loop.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the merge wrapper deciding the replay window per underlying store (pre-genesis vs main) instead of delegating
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every other method of HistoryStoreMerger branches between the pre-genesis and main store, so adding a window/lookback parameter at this layer is a natural refactor that the check would then not cover.

O9_family: replay / transaction double-inclusion caused by an off-by-one validity-window lookback (CWE-193 off-by-one enabling CWE-294 capture-replay)

O10_build.toolchain: cargo workspace, edition 2024 (Cargo.toml:162), version 1.5.0; no rust-toolchain file in the tree, so a recent stable toolchain; the MDBX database crate needs a C toolchain to build
O10_build.project_tests: Unit tests in blockchain/src/history run on a volatile in-memory MDBX database (e.g. blockchain/src/history/history_store.rs:949, blockchain/src/history/history_store_index.rs:819), so no network or service is needed. The two tests this fix rewrites already exist at the pinned commit (blockchain/src/history/history_store.rs:1093, blockchain/src/history/history_store_index.rs:816) and assert the pre-fix boundary, so a correct fix must rewrite them; the merged-store variant at blockchain/src/history/merged_history_store.rs:446 is unchanged. cargo test -p nimiq-blockchain --lib.

j.j_sites_touched: blockchain/src/history/validity_store.rs (the other two files in the commit only rewrite tests)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Read 'off by one' literally and shift the boundary by one block (> to >=, or last_bn - window + 1) instead of widening the lookback by blocks_per_batch.

out_of_scope_notes: HistoryStoreMerger::tx_in_validity_window queries only the main store (blockchain/src/history/merged_history_store.rs:170-176), so epoch-0 pre-genesis hashes are never consulted; outside this advisory's property because an epoch-0 transaction cannot be valid at any current height (primitives/transaction/src/lib.rs:380-387).
